items.text: Kobu akirot naka EJAKAIT mama ajai ebe:
“Okoku loka etuŋanan, kiner kidwe luka ikonituŋa, kolimok kes ebe, Naayaunia ekileŋ akwap,
arai kelemut ituŋa luka akwap kaŋin ituŋanan idiopet kotomakec, kodakakis ŋes araun ekedaranikec: a arai kekutaki arupepe naeanyunia ekileŋ ebunokini akwap, ka aikwenyar ituŋa;
kosodi nm yeniirari eporoto loka arupepe, komam ecamuni aikwenyario, arai kebu ekileŋ alemar ŋes, eiaunete aokotoke akouke kilopet.
Abu kiira eporoto loka arupepe, komam ecamunit aikwenyario; ejaunete aokotoke kamaken. Konye araikeeamunit aikwenyario tikituku akeijar.
Konye arai keanyu ekedaran ekileŋ ebuni, komam ekutakini arupepe, komam ituŋa ikwenyario, kobu do ekileŋ, kolema ituŋanan kamakec; elemario kanumam adoliteke, konye etepeseni akeokot kama kekedaran.
“Aso do jo, okoku loka etuŋanan, kadakak jo araun ekedaran loka ekek loka Isirael; asa kiira akirot naka aitukuka, kikwenya kes kanukaŋ.
Arai kalimok ikaronon ebe, Ŋo ikaronon, abeit itwani, komam jo inera aikwenyar ikaronon ii korotoke; etwanikini ikaronon ii numam adoliteke, konye etepeseni akeokot kamakon.
Konye arai kikwenya ijo ikaronon aibelokin korotoke, komam ŋes ibelokini korotoke; etwanikini numam adoliteke, konye iyuuni ijo akoniijar.
“Ka jo da, okoku loka etuŋanan, kolimok ekek loka Isirael ebe: Inerasi kwanata ebe, ‘Ejaas adiakanaretakosi ka aronisiokosi kasio, kiin kakes; kikwaikini do ai kijari?’

Kolimok kes ebe, Ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, Kwape ajaria, Mam esiyalamikinit atwanare naka ikaronon; konye kibelokin ikaronon korotoke kojar: kibelokinos, kibelokinos kotoma orotinikus lueroko; kanukinyo itwakiata, ijo ekek loka Isirael?

Ijo da, okoku loka etuŋanan, kolimok idwe luka ikonituŋa ebe, Adolit naka ikadoliton mam eyuuni ŋes kapaaran naka adiakarike; ido da aronis naka ikaronon mam isibirori kapaaran naibelokinor anyoun karonisike: kwabo mam epedori ikadoliton aijar kanuka adoliteke kapaaran naediakaria.
Arai kalimok ikadoliton ebe abeit ejari; arai kemunokin akedolit, kiswama numam adolit, mam iitunio adio kaswamisioke nuadolito; konye etwanikini numam adoliteke nueswamat.
Ido bobo, arai kalimok ikaronon ebe, ‘Abeit itwani’; arai kibelokin ainyein akeronis, ka aswam da nuibusakinito ka nuedolito;
Arai kinyakaki aititiŋet, kotac Iukekokwarit, kolosenene kokisila luka aiiar, komam iswamai numam adolit; abeit eiari, mam etwani.
Mam iirunio adio karonisioke nueswamat: eswamat nuibusakinito nuedolito; abeit ejari.
“Konye ebalas idwe luka ikonituŋa ebe, ‘Mam eriana erot loka EJAKAIT’: kwabo ikecerotin kes mam erianas.
Naibelokinor ikadoliton ainyein akedolit, kiswama numam adolit, etwanikini ŋun.
Naibelokinor ikaronon ainyein akeronis, kiswama nuibusakinito nuedolito, ejarakini ŋun.
Konye ibalas yesi ebe, ‘Mam eriana erot loka EJAKAIT.’ Wu jo ekek loka Isirael, katubokini yes, ninitunanan kwape ejaatar ikerotin.”
Kosodi kanen, kokaru lokitomonet kaarei loka aijoreoriokosi, kolap Iokitomonet, kapaaran nakikanyet naka elap, kobu etuŋanan mama ajai lokekui koYerusaletn, ebala ebe, “Ebiror ere.”
Kabunok akan naka EJAKAIT eboŋ, eroko lokekui ebuno; kesiwoona akaituk, kiton nekadolokinio ŋol tupuruc; koonar akaituk kwabo mam bobo abanaana.
Kobu akirot naka EJAKAIT mama ajai ebe:
“Okoku loka etuŋanan, lueiaas aiboisio nu nuiswapito nuka akwap naka Isirael inerenenasi ebe, ‘Arai Aburaam ediopet, kirum akwap; konye oni kirai luipu; kiinakinitai akwap araut alrumet.’
Aso kolimok kes ebe, Inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Inyamete lneiaas aokot, iteluorete akusikonye mama ejaas aputosiakus, ibukorete da aokot; irumete tope yesi akwap?
Ieatunito kokilenakus, iswamaete nuketal, komunaaros nolirunanan kaberu naka eidunyeteke: irumete tope yesi akwap?

Ilimokini kes kwanata ebe, Inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Kwape ajaria, abeit etwakete nul kere luejaas aiboisio nuiswapito kekilen, ka Ŋin da yenejai kina ais akorakini ŋes konyama itian; ka ŋul da Iueiaas abwasin nuegogon ka abuai da etwakete atular.
Etarauni akwap asilio ka aumokinet, enaŋi eitur loka akepedor; esilioros ironan luka Isirael, komam ituŋanan yenitori nen.
Kosodete do ejenunete ebe arai eoŋ EJAKAIT, naetuluoria akwap asilio ka aumokinet, kanuka italesiakec kere lueswamata.

“Ka jo da, okoku loka etuŋanan, kinerasi jo idwe luka ikonituŋa karwatatin, kokekia da luka itogoi, kineranakinos, ninitunanan konaceke, ebe, ‘Kaloto, kenainait, kapuputu akirot naelomunit kama ejai EJAKAIT.’
Epote neijai kwape eponiata ituŋa, iboikinos kakonyenekon kwape ikatuŋa, epupunete akakiro, konye mam iswamaete: naarai itodikinete amin naepol kanaiepakec, konye ekecetau etupari aimakirakec.
Ido koany, irai kamakee ekosio loejok noi loka ekayoot loitalakarit noi, loejeni airam jokan; naarai epupunete akonikiro, konye mam iswamaete.
Naitodolikinere ŋun, (koany itodolikinio), kosodete do ejenunete ebe ajai enabi kidinikec.’
